estimator.features: exact frozen 66D admissible base plus canonical 24D relational sidecar
estimator.initialization: same model initialization function and zero-based ascending fold index as SYMMETRY-03
estimator.training_order: frozen global row order, contiguous slices, no shuffle

failure_policy: preserve the failing qualification receipt and stop; no feature, estimator, threshold, support, task, or seed rescue under this identity

implementation_amendment.scope: fit-launch precondition field-name reconciliation and integrity-launch import path only; D values, training algorithm, thresholds, task definition, and support rule unchanged

next_step_after_pass: eligible to prepare a separately sealed measured REACH-03 namespace; this contract does not authorize its execution
pass_conditions: at least 10 of 12 blocks are evaluable
pooled held-out balanced error <= 0.10 and Omega_hat >= 0.80

support_rule.empty_or_one_class_blocks: retain; blockwise balanced error undefined; count as non-evaluable; no replacement; available rows remain in pooled scoring
support_rule.evaluable_block: held-out U-star rows contain at least one Y=+1 and at least one Y=-1
support_rule.pooled_population: all available out-of-fold U-star rows across the frozen twelve blocks, with inverse-inclusion weights and equal class weighting

task.labels: two positive and two negative, deterministically shuffled

task_bank.task_seed_rule: task_pattern_seed and simulator_seed equal block_id; fresh v0.2 range

truth_firewall: write and hash all twelve held-out prediction streams; pass independent integrity before opening held-out truth
